policy: 24 consumed synthetic rear-room captures with panel and music. Use each original Nyx open and the archived AEC/AGC FIFO. Execute the patched board mic_task wake branch, gate, FIFO and P4 Opus. Single-threaded simulated 256-sample reads, 160-sample AGC blocks, nominal 10/20 ms sleeps, zero-time bursts, unmuted, logical clock starts at mic_task entry at OPEN. Pad only the final partial frame with zeros as in the archived codec. Immediately connected and ready versus connected at 500 ms and provider ready at 1500 ms. Peer accepts every send. Compare all immediate packets against the archived bytes. Fresh decoder per sent stream. waited_trimmed drops the decoded prefix after decoding. immediate_prefixed concatenates that same decoded prefix with the immediate PCM. No controller, network, receiver VAD, jitter, workload timing, resource or hardware measurements.
